papers.title: Cross-linking of poly(methyl methacrylate) by oxozirconate and oxotitanate clusters
papers.scope_note: This study uses oxozirconate and oxotitanate clusters as cross-linkers in thermally initiated methyl methacrylate polymerization. It does not investigate photoresist materials or lithographic performance; solvent extraction and swelling are not lithographic development experiments.

papers.title: Patterned Growth of P-Type MoS2 Atomic Layers Using Sol–Gel as Precursor
papers.scope_note: This study uses a Mo-containing sol–gel with W impurity for PDMS-stamp imprinting followed by thermal sulfurization into patterned MoS2, not as a radiation-sensitive photoresist (MAIN:p6, MAIN:p7, MAIN:p8). Tungsten oxide clusters are investigated as electronic dopants rather than resist materials.

papers.title: Sub-10-nm Lithography for Sn4–Oxo Clusters: Effect of Molecular Polarity on Sensitivity and Resolution
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of Sn4-TF and Sn4-2F tin–oxo cluster resists under EBL, EUVL and DUV, including developer selection and UV pre-irradiation.

papers.title: Tin-Oxo Nanocluster Composite Films as Positive-Tone Photoresist for Extreme UV Lithography
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of positive-tone tin-oxo cage resist DSBTOC and its DHP composites, including EBL, EUVL, UV patterning, stability and etching. Metal-free materials are retained only as formulation components or experimental controls; introduction-only literature examples are not exhaustively extracted.

papers.title: Tin-Oxo Nanocluster Extreme UV Photoresists Equipped with Chemical Features for Atmospheric Stability and High EUV Sensitivity
papers.scope_note: Original study of fluoroalkylated tin-oxo nanocluster N-TOC6 in EBL and EUV lithography, with DSBTOC as a reference resist and supportive underlayer. BTOC and TOC6 are precursor clusters; the commercial KrF polymer is retained only as an experimentally measured etch reference.

papers.title: Synergistic Tripartite Molecular Design of Halogen-Engineered Organotin Clusters Enabling 10 mJ cm-2 EUV Lithography
papers.scope_note: Direct study of dinuclear oxygen-bridged organotin molecular resists with halobenzoate and triethanolamine-derived ligands, tested by EBL and EUV lithography. Sn2-ben is an insoluble structural comparator, not a demonstrated patterned resist.

papers.title: Nanoscale Ferromagnetic Cobalt-Doped ZnO Structures Formed by Deep-UV Direct-Patterning
papers.scope_note: Experimental negative-tone metal-organic direct-patterning precursor for Co:ZnO, using 193 nm DUV. No discrete atomically resolved metal-oxo cluster is established; irradiation is described as creating crosslinked M–O–M networks.

papers.title: Fabrication of Metal–Organic Framework Thin Films Using Programmed Layer-by-Layer Assembly Techniques
papers.scope_note: Review of layer-by-layer SURMOF thin-film assembly with a relevant non-cluster electron-beam resist/deposition example (MAIN:b55–MAIN:b56). The retained result is literature-reported focused electron-beam processing, not this study's experiment or demonstrated metal-oxo cluster photolithography.

papers.title: Antimony-Oxo-Cluster-Based Polymers as Positive-Tone EBL/EUV Photoresists: Lithography Performance Enhancement by Network Structure Modulation
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of a crystallographically resolved binuclear antimony-oxo precursor and thiol-ene-derived cluster polymers as EBL/EUV resists. Precursor crystallography does not establish atomically resolved polymer or coated-film structures.

papers.title: Pioneering Carboxylated Zirconium Oxo Cluster Resist for Precision Nanoscale Patterning
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of a benzoate-coordinated zirconium oxo cluster negative-tone EBL resist. EUV is a prospective application, not a demonstrated exposure modality in the supplied evidence.

papers.title: Amphoteric aqueous hafnium cluster chemistry
papers.scope_note: This study investigates synthesis, crystal structure and aqueous oligomerization of a peroxo-hydroxo Hf6 cluster, motivated by alkaline development of HafSOx resists (MAIN:b3–b5, MAIN:b10–b17). It does not demonstrate Hf6 as a photoresist or report condition-specific lithography performance; solution-aging and structural characterization are therefore not extracted as resist properties.

papers.title: Monomeric Chini-Type Triplatinum Clusters Featuring Dianionic and Radical-Anionic π*-Systems
papers.scope_note: This paper concerns synthesis, electronic structure and electrophilic reactivity of Chini-type triplatinum carbonyl/isocyanide clusters, not photoresists or lithography (MAIN:b2, MAIN:b14, MAIN:b17). Bridging carbonyl ligands are not metal-oxo groups; no resist application is demonstrated.

papers.title: Alkyltin Keggin Clusters Templated by Sodium
papers.scope_note: Organotin metal-oxo cluster discovery and lithography-relevant film preparation study, without demonstrated radiation patterning. Retained results concern β-NaSn13 coating morphology and solution stability; Sn12 and crude n-BuSnOOH serve mainly as chemical characterization comparators.

papers.title: Improving the Lithography Sensitivity of Atomically Precise Tin-Oxo Nanoclusters via Heterometal Strategy
papers.scope_note: Four crystallographically resolved heterometallic tin-oxo clusters were evaluated as negative-tone EBL resists. EUV absorption is discussed qualitatively; no EUV patterning experiments on these four materials are reported.

papers.title: Polymer Films’ Residual Stress Attenuation from the Supramolecular Complexation with Ultra-Small Nanoparticles for High Resolution Nanoimprint Lithography
papers.scope_note: This study concerns residual-stress attenuation in PVA–Keggin phosphotungstic acid composites for non-photochemical nanoimprint lithography. Despite containing metal-oxo clusters, the composites are replication materials and molds rather than demonstrated metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresists; the separate UV-glue molding example does not establish photoresist behavior of these composites (MAIN:b3, MAIN:b11–MAIN:b16; SI1:p3–SI1:p4, SI1:p17).

papers.title: Selenite-Directed Organotin-Oxo Macrocycles for Nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Original study of four crystallographically resolved selenite-directed organotin-oxo macrocycles, with EBL performance reported for Sn12-α and Sn12Fe18. EUV suitability is discussed, but no EUV lithography experiment is supplied.

papers.title: Atomically Precise Interfacial Engineering on Tin-Silicon Oxo Clusters for Sub-8 nm Lithography
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of atomically resolved tin-oxo cluster precursors, including silicon-functionalized ligands, for negative-tone EBL and preliminary EUV lithography. Precursor crystallography and solution NMR do not establish retention of the molecular structure in coated or exposed films.

papers.title: Electron-Induced C─F Bond Activation in Sn6-oxo Cluster Resist for Enhanced Sensitivity and Sub-10-nm Patterning
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of five crystallographically resolved Sn6-oxo cluster precursors used as negative-tone resists, including EBL comparisons and FPAA DUV/EUV patterning. Table S5 etch comparators are retained separately as literature comparisons, not experiments from this study.

papers.title: Hybrid Inorganic-Organic Rotaxanes and Related Compounds
papers.scope_note: Review of hybrid inorganic-organic rings and rotaxanes with a relevant lithography section on metal-fluoride/carboxylate molecular resists. Retained results are literature comparisons, not new resist experiments; unrelated magnetic, host-guest and synthetic results are excluded.

papers.title: Atomically Precise Ti–Zr Heterometallic Oxo Clusters for High-Sensitivity and High-Resolution Single-Component Extreme Ultraviolet Photoresists
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of atomically resolved Ti–Zr oxo-cluster precursors used as single-component negative-tone resists, with TiZr1/TiZr2 EBL sensitivity comparisons and detailed TiZr2 EBL/EUV patterning, etching and stability results.

papers.title: Fluorine Modification Strategy for Switching Lithographic Polarity of Sb2−Oxo Clusters: Conversion of Negative-Tone to Positive-Tone Patterns†
papers.scope_note: Experimental Sb2-oxo cluster resists tested by EBL, with negative-tone Sb2-PA and positive-tone fluorinated derivatives. EUV is motivation only; no EUV lithography experiment is supplied.

papers.title: Halogenated Metal-Organic Clusters for High-Resolution Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography Resists†
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of halogenated hexanuclear cerium hydroxo/oxo-cluster resists for EUV and EBL, with a halogen-free comparator. Table S1 literature benchmarks are distinguished from this study's experiments.

papers.title: Improving the Lithographic Performance of Tetranuclear Organotin Resist via Additives with Active Ligands
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of tetranuclear organotin-oxo clusters and a Sn-opy/Sn-mCl blend for negative-tone lithography. Selected literature comparisons are retained from Table S4, separately from this study.

papers.title: Recent Progress of Nonchemically-Amplified Resists for High-Resolution Lithography†
papers.scope_note: Review of nonchemically amplified resists, including directly relevant metal-oxo clusters and related metal-containing nanoparticles, complexes, polymers and deposited films. Extracted results are literature comparisons, not experiments performed by this review; purely organic resist sections and incidental material citations are excluded.

papers.title: Hybrid EUV Resists with Mixed Organic Shells: A Simple Preparation Method
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of mixed-carboxylate Ti8 and Zr6 metal-oxo EUV resists, with open-frame contrast curves and a previously studied Zr6Mc12 comparison. Single-ligand precursors are retained for relevant identity and processability context, not as invented lithography experiments.

papers.title: Enhanced Solubility of Zirconium Oxo Clusters from Diacetoxyzirconium(IV) Oxide Aqueous Solution as Inorganic Extreme-Ultraviolet Photoresists
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of methacrylate/acetate zirconium oxo clusters as negative-tone EUV resists, with a Zr6O4 methacrylate cluster comparator tested in the same study.

papers.title: Monoalkyl Tin Nano-Cluster Films Reveal a Low Environmental Impact under Simulated Natural Conditions
papers.scope_note: Direct study of a monoalkyl tin oxo-hydroxo cluster identified as an EUV resist precursor, but experiments concern film morphology and environmental leaching/toxicity rather than lithographic performance. Retained preparation and application-relevant film properties do not establish exposure or patterning results.

papers.title: Non-lithographic SERS Substrates: Tailoring Surface Chemistry for Au Nanoparticle Cluster Assembly
papers.scope_note: This study concerns non-lithographic assembly of thioctic-acid-functionalized Au nanoparticles on chemically modified PS-b-PMMA templates for SERS sensing (MAIN:b3–MAIN:b5, MAIN:b28). These are not photoresists, and cited lithographic approaches are background rather than this study's resist experiments.

papers.title: Irradiation Accelerated Hydrolysis of Soluble Keplerate Titanium–Bismuth Oxo Clusters with Complete Surface Ligands Exchange Behavior for Direct Oxides Nanopatterning
papers.scope_note: Original study of negative-tone EBL using BiTiL1 titanium–bismuth oxo clusters and hydrolysis-derived oxide patterns. BiTiL2–BiTiL6 are structurally characterized ligand-exchanged analogues, not demonstrated lithography materials here; EUV use is prospective.

papers.title: Regulation and Synthesis of Mixed-Ligand Titanium-Oxide Nanoparticles for 12 nm Nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental negative-tone titanium-oxide nanoparticle resists with aromatic carboxylate ligands, evaluated by EBL and 365 nm UV lithography. EUV results appear only in literature comparisons, not as experiments on the titanium-oxide resists.

papers.title: Ligand-Mediated Nuclearity Tuning of Tin Oxo Clusters for Advanced Lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental EBL study of ligand-dependent Sn6 and Sn3 oxo-cluster resists. 12-SnOC is a characterized high-nuclearity benchmark without identifiable lithography performance data here; EUV is discussed as motivation, not demonstrated.

papers.title: Polarity-engineered Sn-Ti cluster photoresists for sub-10-nm high-resolution lithography
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of three heterometallic Sn–Ti oxo-cluster negative-tone resists, with developer-dependent EBL and EUV lithography.

papers.title: Theoretical Insights into the Solubility Polarity Switch of Metal-Organic Nanoclusters for Nanoscale Patterning
papers.scope_note: Experimental Zr6O4(OH)4(C4H5O2)12 nanocluster photoresists, with and without PAG, evaluated by UV, DUV, EBL and EUV; conventional methacrylate-modified ZrO2 nanoparticles serve as experimental comparators.

papers.title: Electron Beam Lithography with Carboxylate-Modified TiO2 Nanoparticles for Sub-20 nm Features
papers.scope_note: Direct negative-tone EBL of carboxylate-capped TiO2 nanoparticles/cluster-like materials, with NIT comparisons, UV demonstrations and post-development conversion to TiO2. Selected explicitly reported literature comparisons are distinguished from this study.

papers.title: Gas phase study of the reactivity of optical coating materials with hydrocarbons using a compact soft x-ray laser
papers.scope_note: The study examines gas-phase Si, Ti, Hf, Zr, and Ru oxide cluster reactivity as a model for protective capping layers on EUV optics, not photoresists (MAIN:p1–MAIN:p5). Proposed optical-coating stability is inferred from gas-phase chemistry and is not resist-film or lithographic performance.

papers.title: Growth of polymer-metal nanocomposites by pulsed laser deposition
papers.journal: Applied Physics A Materials Science and Processing
papers.scope_note: This study concerns pulsed laser deposition of Ag, Au, Pd and Cu clusters in PC and PMMA, their morphology, optical absorption and growth mechanisms, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. The 248 nm laser and reported fluences are deposition conditions, not lithographic exposures; cluster sizes and AFM topography are not lithographic pattern dimensions or LER/LWR.

papers.title: Thermal property of TiO2-fluoropolymer fiber nanocomposites
papers.scope_note: The study concerns thermal decomposition and melting of TiO2–poly(MAA-co-TFA)/PVDF electrospun fiber nanocomposites prepared by blending or surface loading (MAIN:p1–MAIN:p3). These are not reported as photoresists, and the thermal and microscopy results do not constitute lithography experiments.

papers.title: Non-alkyl tin-oxo clusters as new-type patterning materials for nanolithography
papers.scope_note: This study experimentally evaluates four non-alkyl tin-oxo cluster resists by EBL on silicon. EUV performance is discussed only as background, not measured for these materials.

papers.title: Alkenyl-type ligands functionalized tin-lanthanide oxo nanoclusters as molecular lithography resists
papers.scope_note: Primary study of atomically resolved tin-lanthanide oxo clusters, with negative-tone EBL experiments on Sn13Er6. EUV suitability is proposed, not experimentally demonstrated; Sn10 performance is a literature comparison.

papers.title: Enhancing performance of Ti-Zn-oxo clusters for advanced lithography: effect of vertical ionization potential on sensitivity
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of four crystallographically characterized Ti–Zn–oxo cluster resists, TZ-4 through TZ-7, evaluated by EBL and EUVL. Crystal structures describe isolated precursors and do not establish preservation of those structures in coated films.

papers.title: Electron-donating effect of metal-organic nanoclusters on sensitivity for nanoscale patterning
papers.scope_note: Experimental zirconium-oxo/benzoate nanoparticle photoresists evaluated by DUV and EBL, with additional Zn- and Hf-based DUV comparisons. Molecular structures are proposed computational models, not crystallographically established coated-film structures.

papers.title: Alkenyl-fluorine synergy for enhanced resolution and reduced line-edge roughness in tin-oxo cluster photoresists
papers.scope_note: This study experimentally evaluates three dinuclear tin-oxo cluster resists using EBL at 30 and 50 kV. Crystalline precursor structures are reported; retention of those structures in coated films is not established.

papers.title: Radiation chemistry of a novel zinc–oxo cluster crosslinking strategy for EUV patterning
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of a zinc–oxo cluster negative-tone EUV resist, with condition-linked patterning results and a proposed C–F-cleavage-induced crosslinking mechanism.

papers.title: Heterometallic Ti-Zr oxo nanocluster photoresists for advanced lithography
papers.scope_note: Original study of heterometallic Ti–Zr oxo nanoclusters: R-2, R-3 and R-4 were tested as negative-tone EBL resists, and R-4 additionally under EUV. R-1 was characterized but had inadequate solubility for the reported resist experiments.

papers.title: Balancing sensitivity and resolution by feedback regulation of free radicals from Sn-C bonds in tin-oxygen clusters EBL photoresist
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of three physical blends of alkyl-functionalized tin-oxo clusters, with EBL contrast, area/line patterning and EUV tests. Pure-cluster benchmarks are distinguished as literature comparisons.

papers.title: Mainstreaming inorganic metal-oxide resists for high-resolution lithography
papers.scope_note: Historical and mechanistic review of HSQ, HafSOx, ZircSOx and tin-oxide nanocluster resists. Reported performance is retained as literature_comparison, including related silicon-based HSQ; no new experiments are identified.

papers.title: Distance-dependent electron hopping conductivity and nanoscale lithography of chemically-linked gold monolayer protected cluster films
papers.scope_note: The study concerns Cu2+-carboxylate-linked, thiolate-protected gold cluster films patterned by microcontact printing or physical removal with AFM/STM tips, not photoresists. Subsequent heating converts patterned cluster films into metallic Au; no radiation-induced resist solubility change or exposure/development process is demonstrated (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p4, MAIN:p5, MAIN:p10–MAIN:p12).

papers.title: 3D ice lithography and post-processing using gold organometallic precursor
papers.scope_note: Non-cluster gold organometallic ice resist patterned by electron-beam cross-linking and sublimation development. This is not a metal-oxo cluster photoresist study.

papers.title: Enhancement of photosensitivity and stability of Sn-12 EUV resist by integrating photoactive nitrate anion
papers.scope_note: Experimental comparison of Sn-12 oxo-cluster resists with nitrate, tosylate and hydroxide counterions. EUV sensitivity was measured using micrometre-scale masks; the reported nanoscale patterns were made by 193 nm ArF lithography, not EUV.

papers.title: Novel Silicon Titanium Diboride Micropatterned Substrates for Cellular Patterning
papers.scope_note: This study concerns Si–TiB2 micropatterned substrates for cell culture, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. TiB2 is deposited by electron-beam evaporation and etched through a separate commercial negative-photoresist mask (MAIN:b6); its surface oxides, film thickness and micropattern dimensions are not resist-performance results.

papers.title: Cu 2+ -loaded cellulose micro-beads applied to the direct patterning of metallic surfaces using a fast and convenient process
papers.scope_note: This study uses Cu2+-loaded, trimellitate-functionalized cellulose microbeads as colloidal templates and metal-ion carriers for electric-field-driven copper electrodeposition, not as photoresists (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p3, MAIN:p8–MAIN:p9). Its patterning results are electro-colloidal lithography rather than exposure-induced resist solubility changes.

papers.title: Organometallic and coordinative photoresist materials for EUV lithography and related photolytic mechanisms
papers.scope_note: Review of metal-oxo nanocluster and organometallic/coordinative resists, including related silicon and metal-xanthate EBL systems. Extracted results are literature comparisons, not new experiments performed in this review.

papers.title: Zn-Ti oxo cluster photoresists for EUV Lithography: Cluster structure and lithographic performance
papers.scope_note: Original study of atomically resolved Ti/Zn–Ti oxo precursors: TZ-1 and TZ-2 tested as negative-tone EBL/EUV resists, with T-2 retained as a film-forming comparator. Crystallographic precursor structures do not establish structural retention in coated films.

papers.title: Origin of the thermal plasticity property of zirconium oxide gels for use in direct thermal nanoimprinting
papers.scope_note: This study investigates zirconium oxide gels for direct thermal nanoimprinting (nano-Rheology Printing), not photoresists or radiation-induced lithography. Pattern formation results from heat and mold pressure; the cluster structures, thermal plasticity and imprint shrinkage reported in MAIN:b15, MAIN:b24 and MAIN:b64 do not establish photoresist performance.

papers.title: Ab initio photodynamics of model EUV photoresists
papers.scope_note: Computational photodynamics study of two mononuclear molecular surrogates for tin-oxo cage photoresists, not an investigation of formulated or patterned resist materials (MAIN:b8, MAIN:b35). The authors explicitly caution that cage-constrained reaction outcomes may differ from these models (MAIN:b38); no condition-specific lithography performance is reported.

papers.title: Alkoxy chain-length engineering in heterometallic In-Sn-oxo clusters for nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Original study of heterometallic In–Sn–oxo cluster resists with negative-tone EBL measurements. EUV suitability is motivational; no EUV exposure experiment or quantitative EUV absorption result is supplied.

papers.title: Multipurpose organic–inorganic hybrid dielectrics with photothermal crosslinking of zirconium-oxo clusters
papers.scope_note: This study experimentally demonstrates negative-tone DUV direct patterning of a methacrylate-capped Zr6-oxo dielectric through exposure-induced insolubilization. Its focus is dielectric performance, not quantified nanoscale lithography; introductory EUV claims and unrelated dielectric comparators are not treated as resist experiments.

papers.title: Synthesis, molecular structures and solution NMR studies of N-heterocyclic carbene-amine silver complexes
papers.scope_note: The supplied evidence describes N-heterocyclic carbene–amine silver coordination chemistry, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. Crystal structures and solution aggregation measurements do not establish a resist application.

papers.title: Hydrothermal syntheses, crystal structures and properties of three coordination frameworks based on a new semirigid ligand and benzenedicarboxylate
papers.scope_note: This study concerns hydrothermal synthesis, crystallographic characterization and fluorescence of Cd, Co and Zn coordination frameworks with a semirigid biimidazole-derived ligand and benzenedicarboxylate. No photoresist or lithography application is reported; fluorescence excitation wavelengths are not lithographic exposure conditions.

papers.title: Synthesis and electronic behaviors of Ce0.5Hf0.5O2/carbon clusters composite material
papers.scope_note: The study reports microwave-calcined Ce0.5Hf0.5O2/carbon-cluster composites, electron-transfer behavior and visible-light photocatalytic reduction of methylene blue, not photoresists or lithographic patterning (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p2, MAIN:p5). The epoxy resin is a synthesis precursor, not a demonstrated resist formulation.

papers.title: Synthesis and characterization of Ta2O5/HfO2/carbon clusters composite materials
papers.scope_note: The study synthesizes and characterizes Ta2O5/HfO2/carbon-cluster composites for visible-light photocatalytic reduction of methylene blue, not photoresists or lithography (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p5, MAIN:p6). Microwave calcination and epoxy-resin precursors are material preparation steps, not resist exposure or processing.

papers.title: Ultralow line edge roughness of hybrid multilayer Extreme ultraviolet resist with vertical molecular wire structure
papers.scope_note: Original lithography study of a Zn-containing alkoxide/thiolate hybrid multilayer deposited by MLD, rather than a discrete metal-oxo cluster. Relevant EUV/EBL results and the experimentally tested PMMA etch comparator are retained; introductory literature examples and the Zn-4MP mechanistic analogue are not treated as resist-performance experiments.

papers.title: Photolithographic properties of tin-oxo clusters using extreme ultraviolet light (13.5 nm)
papers.scope_note: Experimental EUV lithography of organotin-oxo materials with counterion and Sn-bound organic-group variation. Discrete cage formulas are reported, but the reviewed evidence does not establish atomic structures or their retention in coated films.

papers.title: Thermal and radiation chemistry of butyltin oxo hydroxo: A model inorganic photoresist
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of a butyltin oxo-hydroxo model resist, including negative-tone EBL and X-ray-induced insolubility. Atomic cluster structure is not established, and low-energy electron experiments simulate EUV radiation chemistry rather than demonstrate EUV lithography.

papers.title: Facile design of red-emitting waveguides using hybrid nanocomposites made of inorganic clusters dispersed in SUS photoresist host
papers.scope_note: Mo6 iodide/carboxylate cluster salts are luminescent dopants in a negative-tone SU8 host patterned into optical waveguides. This is related cluster-containing photoresist work, not a metal-oxo resist or evidence that the clusters themselves drive the photoresist response.

papers.title: Formation of thorium-disodium fluoride crystals by electron-beam evaporation
papers.scope_note: The supplied title identifies a study of thorium-disodium fluoride crystal formation by electron-beam evaporation, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. This classification relies principally on the manifest title because the supplied article text is severely corrupted.

papers.title: Functional nanostructures by organized macromolecular-metallic hybrid systems
papers.scope_note: This study reports block-copolymer micelle self-assembly of metallic Au nanoparticles and oxygen-plasma removal of the polymer to form nanoparticle arrays, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist lithography. UV/electron-beam reduction is mentioned as background; no exposure-dependent resist patterning or development experiment is reported.

papers.title: The photochemical metal organic deposition of manganese oxide films from films of manganese(II) 2-ethylhexanoate: a mechanistic study
papers.scope_note: This study investigates the mechanism of blanket-UV photochemical metal-organic deposition of manganese oxide from manganese(II) 2-ethylhexanoate films, not photoresist development or lithographic performance. Lithographic deposition is mentioned as a potential application, but no patterned exposure, development experiment or lithographic performance result is reported.

papers.title: Direct electron beam writing of nanostructures using passivated gold clusters
papers.scope_note: Organic-ligand-passivated metallic Au clusters serve as a negative-tone direct EBL precursor through beam-induced ligand removal and aggregation. This is related metal-organic cluster lithography, not a metal-oxo resist study.

papers.title: Electron-beam exposure characteristics of a novel Ru-PMMA composite resist
papers.scope_note: Original EBL study of a metal-carbonyl/hydride Ru-cluster additive in PMMA, not a metal-oxo resist. Includes this study's pure-PMMA control.

papers.title: Nanostructuring by ultrathin diblock copolymer/titanium composite films
papers.scope_note: MAIN:p1–MAIN:p4 describe self-assembled PS-b-P2VP films coated with vapor-deposited titanium for pattern transfer into mica by Ar+ sputter etching. These are polymer/metal lithographic masks, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists; electron-beam evaporation deposits Ti and Ar+ irradiation erodes the mask rather than producing an exposure-dependent solubility change.

papers.title: Extreme Ultraviolet and Beyond Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography Using Amorphous Zeolitic Imidazolate Resists Deposited by Atomic/Molecular Layer Deposition
papers.scope_note: Experimental metal-organic photoresist study of amorphous zinc-imidazolate films, not discrete metal-oxo clusters. Includes EUV, BEUV and EBL results, with prior EBL performance distinguished as literature comparison.

papers.title: Bismuth-oxo Clusters for Next Generation Extreme Ultraviolet Light Photolithography
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of hfac-ligated bismuth-oxo cluster resists, reporting EUV solubility-switch sensitivity and preliminary EBL patterning. EUV nanoscale patterning is deferred to future work.

papers.title: Metal-Organic Framework-Inspired Metal-Containing Clusters for High-Resolution Patterning
papers.scope_note: Original study of discrete zinc carboxylate cluster photoresists for UV, DUV, EBL and EUV patterning, with experimentally evaluated ZnO nanoparticles as a non-cluster comparator. Zn-BA is crystallographically resolved; Zn-mTA is supported by modeling rather than single-crystal resolution.

papers.title: Chemical Modification Mechanisms in Hybrid Hafnium Oxo-methacrylate Nanocluster Photoresists for Extreme Ultraviolet Patterning
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of HfMAA metal-oxo nanocluster resist solubility switching under EUV and low-energy electron irradiation, with HfIBA and HfBA controls. The emphasis is reaction mechanisms and development retention rather than resolved nanoscale patterning performance.

papers.title: Organotin Carboxylate Reagents for Nanopatterning: Chemical Transformations during Direct-Write Electron Beam Processes
papers.scope_note: Direct negative-tone EBL study of two discrete organotin oxo clusters and a related monometallic organotin resist. EUV relevance is discussed, but this study reports electron-beam, not EUV lithography experiments.

papers.title: Nonaqueous Chemistry of Group 4 Oxo Clusters and Colloidal Metal Oxide Nanocrystals
papers.scope_note: Review of group 4 oxo-cluster and oxide-nanocrystal chemistry, with brief relevant discussions of cluster-based EUV patterning (MAIN:b124) and non-cluster nanocrystal UV resists (MAIN:b208). Retained records are qualitative literature comparisons, not this study's resist experiments; unrelated synthesis and characterization are excluded.

papers.title: Chiral Inorganic Nanostructures
papers.scope_note: This review concerns chiral inorganic nanostructures, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b9). Its lithography discussion describes fabrication of chiroplasmonic structures rather than resist materials or condition-specific resist performance (MAIN:b202–MAIN:b209).

papers.title: Organic-Inorganic High-Valence Sn18-oxo Clusters: Direct Utilization of an Inorganic Sn(IV) Source to Improve the Nuclearity and Electrocatalytic CO2Reduction Properties
papers.scope_note: This study reports synthesis, crystal structures and electrocatalytic CO2 reduction of Sn18-oxo and Sn6-oxo clusters, not photoresist experiments (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p2, MAIN:p6). EUV lithography and nanolithography appear only as background applications or references, without reported resist performance.

papers.title: Synthesis and Characterizations of a Nonalkyl Tin Oxo Cluster and its Application as High EUV Absorption Coefficient and Etch Resistant Inorganic Resist for EUV Lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental nonalkyl tin oxo cluster resist studied by EBL and EUV lithography. All performance measurements used an unpurified product, not an isolated pure cluster; the molecular structure is proposed rather than crystallographically resolved.

papers.title: Ligand Regulation and Mechanism Study of Organotin Carboxylate Resists in DUV Lithography
papers.scope_note: Original experiments on four nonchemically amplified, molecular organotin carboxylate DUV resists. Precursors are not established metal-oxo clusters; exposure is proposed to form a cross-linked tin-oxo network.

papers.title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Electron-Beam Lithography of Tetakis(Triphenylstannyl) Orthosilicate and Tetrakis(Triacetoxystannyl) Orthosilicate for the Development of Inorganic Molecular EUV Resists
papers.scope_note: Original study of orthosilicate-centered tetratin molecular resist candidates. Acetoxy material was evaluated by EBL, not EUV; the crystallographically resolved phenyl precursor was limited by poor film processability.

papers.title: Ge 14 Br 8 (P n Pr 3 ) 4 : A Material for Laser-Induced Printing of Elemental Germanium
papers.scope_note: This study concerns additive direct laser writing of elemental germanium from a soluble metalloid Ge14Br8(PnPr3)4 precursor, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist lithography. The commercial positive photoresist ma-P 1215 is used only for subsequent Ti/Au contact fabrication; its processing conditions are not performance data for the Ge cluster.

papers.title: Computational Study of Organotin Oxide Systems for Extreme Ultraviolet Photoresist
papers.scope_note: Computational study of tin-oxo cluster and organotin photoresists, with experimental lithography results taken from prior literature. No new exposure, coating or development experiments are reported.

papers.title: XUV Absorption Spectroscopy and Photoconversion of a Tin-Oxo Cage Photoresist
papers.scope_note: TinOAc is a molecular tin-oxo cage photoresist. This study measures broadband XUV absorption and photoconversion, not developed lithographic patterns; exposure records below describe spectroscopy samples rather than dose-to-size experiments.

papers.title: VIS-XUV Optical Constants and Electronic Band Parameters of a Tin-Oxo Cage Photoresist (Sn12O24C52H120)
papers.scope_note: Direct study of TinOAc metal-oxo cage photoresist films, focused on optical constants and electronic energy dissipation rather than lithographic patterning. Material properties are retained, with no invented lithography records.

papers.title: Metal-Core-Specific Screening with Machine Learning: Accelerating the Discovery of Metal Oxide Clusters for Enhanced EUV Lithography Resolution
papers.scope_note: Computational screening of metal-oxo cluster EUV resist candidates using DFT and machine learning, not experimental lithography. Predicted HOMO energies and ionization potentials are screening proxies, not demonstrated resolution or dose performance.

papers.title: Competing Sn–O and Sn–C Bond Cleavage Pathways Control Cross-Linking in Tin-Oxo Clusters
papers.scope_note: Computational mechanistic study of tin-oxo cage photoresists, not a lithographic performance experiment. Simulated cross-linking and bond stability are retained as calculated properties; no exposure or development records are inferred.

papers.title: DFT Study on CO2- and H2O-Enhanced Solubility Contrast in Tin-Oxo Cage Photoresists
papers.scope_note: Directly studies a methyl tin-oxo cage photoresist using DFT to explain CO2/H2O-enhanced solubility contrast under DUV/EUV pathways. Reaction intermediates are not separate tested resist formulations, and no condition-specific lithographic performance records are supported.

papers.title: Theoretical Investigation on Lithographic Properties of Zinc–Oxo and Cadmium–Oxo Clusters Ligated with Differently Substituted Benzoic Acids
papers.scope_note: Computational study of ten Zn–oxo and Cd–oxo cluster photoresist models using DFT/TD-DFT; no condition-specific lithography experiments are reported. Calculated properties are retained, with data_origin set to uncertain because the schema has no study_calculation category.

papers.title: Single Rare-Earth Ion Doped Tin-Oxo Nanocluster Photoresists for High-Resolution Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of crystallographically characterized rare-earth-doped tin-oxo nanocluster negative-tone resists for EBL and EUV lithography. Table S5 supplies separate literature comparisons, including related molecular organotin resists.

papers.title: Synergistic Enhancement Effects of Heterogeneous Isomorphism Clusters in Response to Irradiation: Sub-10 nm Nanolithography and Nanoscale Etching Transfer
papers.scope_note: Experimental negative-tone Ti–Hf/Ti–Zr oxo-cluster EBL resists and mixed-cluster formulations, with condition-specific patterning, stability and etch-transfer results. Table S1 contains literature comparisons, not additional experiments by this study.

papers.title: Fabrication of Single Metal-Organic Framework Crystal Devices to Inform Energy Conversion Platforms
papers.scope_note: This study fabricates electrical contacts to Mo2(isonicotinate)4 MOF crystals using separate conventional PMMA/MMA resists; the MOF is the device channel, not a photoresist (MAIN:b8, MAIN:b18, MAIN:b21; SI1:p3). Reported EBL doses and electrode dimensions therefore do not establish metal-organic resist performance.

papers.title: Fluorescent Labeling to Investigate Nanopatterning Processes in Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental negative-tone EUV lithography of zirconium oxo methacrylate clusters and their fluorescent CB-ligand derivative, including contrast tests and a condition-linked patterning result.

papers.title: Smart Biointerfaces via Click Chemistry-Enabled Nanopatterning of Multiple Bioligands and DNA Force Sensors
papers.scope_note: This study patterns biomolecules using hole-mask colloidal lithography with sacrificial PMGI/LOR polymer, Ti hard masks and Cr disks, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (b0017–b0021, b0032, b0077–b0078). Metal deposition and removal provide physical barriers; neither e-beam evaporation nor SEM imaging constitutes resist exposure.

papers.title: Layer-Ordered Organooxotin Clusters for Extreme-Ultraviolet Photolithography
papers.scope_note: Original research on SnCm organooxotin resists, with condition-specific UV, EBL and EUV experiments on SnC3. Table S1 contains literature comparisons, not experiments performed in this study.

papers.title: Additive-Assisted Forming High-Quality Thin Films of Sn-Oxo Cluster for Nanopatterning
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of aromatic tetranuclear Sn-oxo photoresists with a Ni-cluster film-forming additive, including DUV, EBL and EUV patterning. Precursor crystal structures are resolved, but coated mixed-film structures are not atomically established.

papers.title: Extreme Ultraviolet Photoresponse of Organotin-Based Photoresists with Borate Counteranions
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of Sn12 oxo-hydroxo cage photoresists with borate counteranions, including developer-dependent dual-tone TinPFPB behavior and 50 nm half-pitch EUV interference patterns for TinPFPB and TinTB. TinOH is retained as the explicitly reported reference resist, not as an invented new lithography experiment.

papers.title: Non-uniform Composition Profiles in Inorganic Thin Films from Aqueous Solutions
papers.scope_note: Original study of composition and density gradients in aqueous inorganic films, including non-cluster HafSOx resist films. Relevant resist-film properties are retained, but no lithography experiments are reported; InGaOx and AlOx are excluded because they serve as general thin-film comparisons rather than demonstrated resists here.

papers.title: Dielectric Modulation of Ionization Energetics in Organotin Extreme Ultraviolet Photoresists
papers.scope_note: Computational study of organotin EUV resist models and solvent-dependent ionization energetics, not a lithography experiment. Calculated ionization potentials are retained as properties; predicted sensitivity improvements are not treated as measured lithographic performance.

papers.title: Effect of Oxygen on Thermal and Radiation-Induced Chemistries in a Model Organotin Photoresist
papers.scope_note: Direct study of a charge-neutral organotin oxo β-Keggin cluster resist, emphasizing thermal and low-energy electron-induced chemistry rather than EUV patterning performance. Prior He-ion patterning and X-ray solubility results are distinguished from this study.

papers.title: Key Role of Very Low Energy Electrons in Tin-Based Molecular Resists for Extreme Ultraviolet Nanolithography
papers.scope_note: TinOH tin-oxo molecular resist studied by low-energy electron exposure, EELS and AFM before/after negative-tone development. EUV sensitivity is a literature comparison, not a new EUV exposure experiment.

papers.title: Development of Nickel-Based Negative Tone Metal Oxide Cluster Resists for Sub-10 nm Electron Beam and Helium Ion Beam Lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental nickel-based metal–organic/metal-oxide cluster negative-tone resist studied using DUV, EBL and helium ion beam lithography. Cluster structure is proposed rather than atomically resolved; EUV use is prospective only.

papers.title: Multiphoton-Excited Deep-Ultraviolet Photolithography for 3D Nanofabrication
papers.scope_note: Direct initiator-free two-photon patterning of MAA-ligated Zr and Ti oxo-cluster solutions into insoluble networks, followed by annealing to metal oxides. Actual illumination is 400 nm, described by the authors as DUV-TPP through its 200 nm-equivalent two-photon energy; nonmetal DPHA and cysteine demonstrations are excluded from this metal-oxo extraction.

papers.title: Macrocycle Network-Aided Nanopatterning of Inorganic Resists on Silicon
papers.scope_note: Experimental organotin BTA and BTA/noria hybrid negative-tone resists forming proposed Sn–O–Sn networks under DUV, EBL and HIBL. These are not established atomically resolved clusters; neat noria controls are retained as related materials.

papers.title: Enhanced Edge Etching Resistance and EUV Lithographic Performance of a Tin-Oxide Photoresist via a Blend Strategy
papers.scope_note: Experimental tin-oxo cluster resists and a two-cluster blend studied by EBL and EUV lithography, with condition-specific patterning, film morphology, thermal and etching results. Cluster (4) prior-work EUV performance is distinguished from this study.

papers.title: Evaluation of Thermal and Radiation Induced Chemistries of Metal Oxo-Hydroxo Clusters for Next-Generation Nanoscale Inorganic Resists
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of aqueous hafnium oxo–hydroxo cluster-derived HafSOx negative-tone resist, including EBL contrast arrays and a two-layer nanopattern. The amorphous film has a nominal average composition and proposed cluster connectivity, not an atomically resolved retained precursor structure.

papers.title: Effect of Ambient Conditions on Radiation-Induced Chemistries of a Nanocluster Organotin Photoresist for Next-Generation EUV Nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Direct study of a sodium-templated butyltin Keggin nanocluster resist using X-ray contrast measurements as a model for EUV radiation chemistry; this study does not report EUV nanopatterning performance.

papers.title: Nanoimprint Directed Assembly of Associating Polymer-Grafted Nanoparticles for Polymer Thin Films with Enhanced Stability
papers.scope_note: This study investigates thermally driven capillary-force nanoimprinting and confinement-directed assembly of PS-grafted TiO2 nanoparticles in polystyrene, not a radiation-sensitive metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist (MAIN:b11, MAIN:b37, MAIN:b39). Reported pattern dimensions and dewetting stability describe thermally molded nanocomposite films rather than exposure/development lithography performance.

papers.title: Geometric Control of Cell Behavior by Biomolecule Nanodistribution
papers.scope_note: This study uses commercial CSAR-6200 electron-beam resist to fabricate platinum patterns for biomolecule immobilization and cell-interaction studies, not metal-oxo or metal-organic resists (b0014–b0015). ITO is a conductive substrate coating, tantalum is an adhesion layer, and platinum forms the deposited patterns; none is identified as the exposure-sensitive resist.

papers.title: Fluorine-Rich Zinc Oxoclusters as Extreme Ultraviolet Photoresists: Chemical Reactions and Lithography Performance
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of fluorine-rich zinc oxocluster negative-tone EUV photoresists, including Zn(TFMA) and mixed-ligand Zn(TFMA)(MA)(TFA), with relevant Zn(MA)(TFA) literature comparisons. Average compositions are retained without claiming atomically resolved coated-film structures. Extraction covers supplied article text, SI text, and only the eight supplied SI page images.

papers.title: Multinuclear Tin-Based Macrocyclic Organometallic Resist for EUV Photolithography
papers.scope_note: Primary study of TTC, a crystallographically resolved trinuclear organotin macrocyclic photoresist forming a proposed Sn–O–Sn network upon irradiation. It is a discrete metal-organic resist rather than an established preformed metal-oxo cluster; relevant comparison-table results are marked literature_comparison.

papers.title: Stimulated Emission Depletion Lithography with Mercapto-Functional Polymers
papers.scope_note: Original experiments use zirconium oxo clusters with polymerizable ligands as components of PETA/DETC hybrid resists for multiphoton and STED lithography. This is optical negative-tone polymerization, not EUV or electron-beam exposure.

papers.title: Molecular Occupancy of Nanodot Arrays
papers.scope_note: The study measures biomolecular occupancy on functionalized AuPd nanodot arrays, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist performance (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p3). PMMA and HSQ are fabrication aids; AuPd is deposited after lithography and subsequently functionalized, rather than exposed as a resist (MAIN:p8, SI1:p2).

papers.title: Alkenyl/Thiol Co-Functionalized Titanium-Oxo Nanoclusters Enable Synergistic Lithography for Enhanced Resolution and Sensitivity
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of titanium-oxo cluster negative-tone EBL resists TOC-2, TOC-3 and TOC-4, with lithographically inactive TOC-1 as a control.

papers.title: Transmission Electron Microscopy Unraveled Ionic Oxygen-Affinity Engineering of Metal Oxo Clusters with Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography Activity
papers.scope_note: Original Sn12Eu8 metal-oxo cluster EBL/EUV resist study with Sn12 as a radiation-response comparator. Readable Table S1 comparisons are distinguished from this study's experiments.

papers.title: Alignment of Gold Clusters on DNA via a DNA-Recognizing Zinc Finger-Metallothionein Fusion Protein
papers.scope_note: This study concerns DNA-templated assembly of gold clusters using a zinc finger–metallothionein fusion protein, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b46, MAIN:b51–MAIN:b52). “DNA lithography” denotes sequence-directed cluster positioning rather than exposure-induced resist patterning.

papers.title: Molecular specifications of a mineral modulation sequence derived from the aragonite-promoting Protein n16
papers.scope_note: This study examines the structure, Ca(II) interactions and calcium carbonate mineralization behavior of the n16N polypeptide, with comparisons to AP7N and AP24N (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p2, SI1:p2). It does not investigate metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresists or lithographic patterning.

papers.title: From Paracrystalline Ru(CO) 4 1D Polymer to Nanosized Ruthenium Metal: A Case of Study through Total Scattering Analysis
papers.scope_note: This paper studies paracrystalline [Ru(CO)4]n and its thermal conversion to faulted ruthenium nanoparticles using total-scattering analysis (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b7, MAIN:b42). Nanolithography is mentioned only as background (MAIN:b2); no metal-organic or metal-oxo photoresist experiment is reported.

papers.title: Lateral assembly of metal nanoparticles directed by nanodomain control in block copolymer thin films
papers.scope_note: This study uses self-assembled PMMA-b-PHEMA films loaded with Pd nanoparticles as reactive-ion-etching masks, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. Pd(acac)2 vapor supplies metal by thermal reduction; the UV patterning mentioned on MAIN:p2 describes previous work rather than this study's experiments.

papers.title: Pyrolysis of polycarbosilanes with pendant nickel clusters: Synthesis and characterization of magnetic ceramics containing nickel and nickel silicide nanoparticles
papers.scope_note: This study concerns nickel-clustered polycarbosilane synthesis and pyrolysis into magnetic ceramics, not photoresist evaluation (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p11). UV irradiation is used for solution-phase polymer metallization (MAIN:p5–MAIN:p6); lithography references describe prior work or prospective applications, not condition-specific resist experiments.

papers.title: Self-Assembly of [Pt 3n (CO) 6n ] 2- (n=4-8) Carbonyl Clusters: from Molecules to Conducting Molecular Metal Wires
papers.scope_note: The paper studies platinum carbonyl cluster self-assembly, crystal packing, electrical resistivity and solution aggregation, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b12, MAIN:b86–MAIN:b89). The proposed printable-metal application is not a demonstrated resist or lithography experiment (MAIN:b11).

papers.title: Polyoxometalate-based vesicle and its honeycomb architectures on solid surfaces
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.scope_note: This study concerns surfactant-encapsulated polyoxometalate vesicles and honeycomb films formed by self-assembly during solvent casting, not metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresists. The supplementary soft-lithography example does not demonstrate a radiation-sensitive resist; pore dimensions and microscopy electron-beam conditions are not lithographic resolution or EBL exposure results.

papers.title: Highly metallized polymers: Synthesis, characterization, and lithographic patterning of polyferrocenylsilanes with pendant cobalt, molybdenum, and nickel cluster substituents
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.scope_note: Original study of metal-organic cluster-substituted polyferrocenylsilane resists, not metal-oxo resists. Includes condition-specific EBL and UV experiments for Mo-PFS 4 and Ni-PFS 6, an unclusterized control, and prior Co-PFS 3a lithography results.

papers.title: Orbital Hybridization of π-Conjugated Ligands with Atomically Precise Metal Clusters for Enhanced Two-Photon Absorption
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.scope_note: This study examines orbital hybridization and solution-phase two-photon absorption of thiolate-protected Au36 clusters, not photoresists or lithographic patterning (MAIN:b7, MAIN:b15, MAIN:b28). The mention of 3D lithography is background motivation only (MAIN:b2); Z-scan measurements and irradiation stability do not establish resist performance.

papers.title: Cycloalkyl Ligand-Engineered Zirconium–Oxo Clusters for Sub-9 nm Electron Beam Lithography with Ultralow Line Edge Roughness
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of cycloalkylcarboxylate-modified zirconium–oxo/hydroxo photoresists, with EBL, EUV, 254 nm optical patterning and etch testing. Supplementary Table 4 contains separately identified literature comparisons.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Assisted Rapid Scalable Synthesis and Assembly Evolution of Lithographic Metal-Oxo Clusters
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of a crystallographically resolved Sn–Ti oxo-cluster negative-tone EBL resist. Extraction focuses on Sn12Ti4-DMF lithography; assembly derivatives without resist tests and the secondary literature comparison are not treated as this study's resist experiments.

papers.title: Correlated Structure and Optical Property Studies of Plasmonic Nanoparticles
papers.scope_note: This review concerns structure–LSPR–SERS correlations in Ag/Au nanoparticles and nanoparticle aggregates, not photoresists (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b6). Nanosphere lithography uses deposition through sphere masks, and AFM manipulation repositions nanoparticles; neither constitutes metal-oxo/metal-organic resist exposure and development (MAIN:b8, MAIN:b67).

papers.title: Rim effects in the adsorption of CO 2 on silica-supported copper oxide clusters: Identifying active sites utilizing electron beam lithography
papers.scope_note: This study examines CO2 adsorption on silica-supported CuOx model catalysts fabricated using EBL, not CuOx as an exposure-sensitive resist (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p3). The conventional resist-assisted fabrication in SI1:p4 does not constitute a metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresist study.

papers.title: Reactions of sulfur dioxide with neutral vanadium oxide clusters in the gas phase. II. Experimental study employing single-photon ionization
papers.scope_note: This paper studies gas-phase reactions of neutral vanadium oxide clusters with SO2 as models for catalysis, not photoresists or lithography (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b6). VUV/EUV radiation is used for mass-spectrometric ionization, not resist patterning (MAIN:b7).

papers.title: Soft lithographic approach to the fabrication of highly ordered 2D arrays of magnetic nanoparticles on the surfaces of silicon substrates
papers.scope_note: This study fabricates magnetic nanoparticle arrays using microcontact-printed self-assembled monolayers, selective dewetting of nitrate solutions and thermal conversion, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:p1–MAIN:p3, MAIN:p7). Reported particle dimensions are not exposure-defined resist resolution; proposed use as etching masks does not establish photoresist performance.

papers.title: Langmuir-Blodgett fabrication of two-dimensional robust cross-linked nanoparticle assemblies
papers.scope_note: The study describes Langmuir–Blodgett assembly of alkanethiolate-protected gold nanoparticles cross-linked with aryl dithiols, followed by UV–ozone cleaning to form quantum dot arrays. This is explicitly nonlithographic fabrication, not metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresist processing (MAIN:b1, MAIN:b32, MAIN:b40).

papers.title: Nanoparticle arrays patterned by electron-beam writing: Structure, composition, and electrical properties
papers.scope_note: Organic-ligand-passivated metallic Au nanoparticle films function as directly writable negative-tone EBL materials. These are related non-cluster resists, not atomically defined metal-oxo resist compounds.

papers.title: Surface design for precise control of spatial growth of a mesostructured inorganic/organic film on a large-scale area
papers.scope_note: The study uses vacuum-UV patterning of organosilane self-assembled monolayers to template subsequent site-selective growth of silica/CTAC composite films, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. The exposure conditions describe template removal, and the reported linewidth, thickness and width variation characterize subsequently deposited composites rather than developed resist patterns (MAIN:p3–MAIN:p6).

papers.title: Gold Nanoparticles: Past, Present, and Future
papers.scope_note: This perspective reviews gold nanoparticle synthesis, electrochemistry, catalysis and plasmonic properties, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:p1). Lithography mentions concern fabrication of metal nanostructures for optical studies, not nanoparticle resist exposure and development (MAIN:p8, MAIN:p10).

papers.title: Lithographic fabrication of model systems in heterogeneous catalysis and surface science studies
papers.scope_note: This paper uses lithographically fabricated metal structures as model catalysts and surface-science specimens; it does not investigate metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. The separate PMMA exposure experiment measures surface elastic modulus rather than relevant resist lithography performance.

papers.title: Nanopatterned electrically conductive films of semiconductor nanocrystals
papers.scope_note: Semiconductor nanocrystals are deposited into electron-beam-patterned PMMA trenches and patterned by lift-off, not used as metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists (MAIN:b9–MAIN:b11; SI1:p1–SI1:p2). The reported 30 nm features describe template-mediated patterning, not direct exposure sensitivity or resolution of a nanocrystal resist.

papers.title: Direct Laser Writing of Photostable Fluorescent Silver Nanoclusters in Polymer Films
papers.scope_note: This study patterns fluorescent silver nanoclusters in silver-containing poly(methacrylic acid) films by direct laser writing, with local polymer ablation and nanocluster stabilization rather than photoresist exposure and development (MAIN:b13, MAIN:b30, MAIN:b35). It does not establish a metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresist or a related resist process; the reported groove widths and writing intensities are therefore not extracted as resist lithography performance.

papers.title: Size- and charge-state-dependent reactivity of azidoacetonitrile with anionic and cationic rhodium clusters Rhn±
papers.scope_note: This study concerns gas-phase reactions of charged rhodium clusters with azidoacetonitrile measured by FT-ICR mass spectrometry, not photoresist materials or lithography (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p3). Photoresists appear only as introductory context; carbide-nitride or CN film formation is a proposed application, not a demonstrated resist experiment (MAIN:p8).

papers.title: Additive manufacturing of 3D nano-architected metals
papers.scope_note: Metal-organic nickel acrylate/acrylic photoresist used for negative-tone two-photon 3D lithography and subsequent conversion to metal. Ni clusters are asserted, but an atomically resolved metal-oxo cluster or retained coated-resin cluster structure is not established.

papers.title: Patterned immobilization of polyoxometalate-loaded mesoporous silica particles via amine-ene Michael additions on alkene functionalized surfaces
papers.scope_note: This study immobilizes polyoxometalate-loaded mesoporous silica particles on alkene-functionalized glass through amine-ene Michael addition, using scanning-probe/contact capillary spotting (b0001, b0015–b0017, b0032). It does not investigate metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresists; post-spotting incubation and washing are chemical coupling and excess-ink removal, not resist baking and development.

papers.title: Room-temperature preparation of metal-oxide nanostructures by DUV lithography from metal-oxo clusters
papers.scope_note: This study experimentally patterns methacrylate-stabilized Ti, Zr and Hf metal-oxo cluster negative-tone resists by 193 nm DUV interference lithography, including post-development mineralization.

papers.title: Chemical and structural investigation of zinc-oxo cluster photoresists for DUV lithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of methacrylate-functionalized zinc-oxo cluster negative-tone DUV resist, including exposure, prebaking, development, aging and post-development thermal conversion.

papers.title: Water soluble derivatives of platinum carbonyl Chini clusters: synthesis, molecular structures and cytotoxicity of [Pt 12 (CO) 20 (PTA) 4 ] 2- and [Pt 15 (CO) 25 (PTA) 5 ] 2-
papers.scope_note: This study concerns synthesis, molecular structures, water solubility and cytotoxicity of PTA-functionalized platinum carbonyl Chini clusters, not photoresist materials or lithography (MAIN:p1, MAIN:p6, MAIN:p7). No resist experiments or lithographic performance results are reported in the supplied evidence.

papers.title: Alkyltin clusters: the less symmetric Keggin isomers
papers.scope_note: This is a synthesis, structural characterization and computational stability study of sodium-centered butyltin Keggin clusters, not a photoresist performance study. The clusters are proposed as proxies for lithographic mechanism studies, but MAIN:p18 explicitly assigns thin-film deposition and lithographic investigations to forthcoming papers.

papers.title: Laser filament bottom-up growth sintering for multi-planar diffraction-limit printing and its application to ultra-transparent wearable thermo-electronics
papers.scope_note: This study reports photothermal laser growth sintering of silver nanoseed/organometallic hybrid inks into conductive electrodes, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist lithography (MAIN:p3, MAIN:p7, MAIN:p8). Its linewidth and laser-power results describe direct metal fabrication rather than resist exposure/development performance.

papers.title: Tuning photoionization mechanisms of molecular hybrid materials for EUV lithography applications
papers.scope_note: Mechanistic study of titanium-oxo cluster candidates for EUV photoresists using gas-phase VUV photoionization and DFT. No coated-film lithography performance is reported in the supplied evidence; records are therefore empty.

papers.title: Review of recent advances in inorganic photoresists
papers.scope_note: Review of inorganic photoresists, including metal-oxo clusters, nanoparticles and related metal-organic molecular and hybrid resists. Extracted results are literature comparisons, not experiments performed in this review.

papers.title: Unravelling the effect of fluorinated ligands in hybrid EUV photoresists by X-ray spectroscopy
papers.scope_note: Experimental comparison of zirconium oxocluster negative-tone EUV resists ZrMc and fluorinated ZrMcF, including contrast curves, dense line/space patterning and exposure-induced chemistry.

papers.title: Mixed-ligand zinc-oxoclusters: Efficient chemistry for high resolution nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Experimental EUV lithography of mixed-ligand tetranuclear zinc-oxo clusters, with condition-specific patterning and unbiased LWR. Table 1 benchmarks are retained separately as literature comparisons, including related non-cluster resists.

papers.title: Role of low-energy electrons in the solubility switch of Zn-based oxocluster photoresist for extreme ultraviolet lithography
papers.scope_note: Direct mechanistic study of a Zn oxocluster EUV resist, with Zn(TFA) as a reference material. This study measures flood-electron-induced chemistry rather than patterned lithographic performance; EUV results are comparisons with prior work.

papers.title: UV and VUV-induced fragmentation of tin-oxo cage ions
papers.scope_note: Mechanistic study of tin-oxo cage photoresist materials using isolated gas-phase ions exposed to 4–35 eV UV/VUV photons, not coated-film lithography. No condition-specific lithography performance records are reported; cited film properties are distinguished from this study's experiments.

papers.title: Molecular bixbyite-like In12-oxo clusters with tunable functionalization sites for lithography patterning applications
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of atomically resolved In12-oxo precursors used as negative-tone EBL resists. InOC-1 to InOC-3 were patterned; InOC-4 and InOC-5 failed film-quality screening and were not evaluated by EBL.

papers.title: Partial decarboxylation of hafnium oxide clusters for high resolution lithographic applications
papers.scope_note: Original experiments on hafnium oxo/hydroxo carboxylate cluster resists, with a preliminary zirconium analogue. Main-text evidence and supplied SI text were reviewed; visual review was limited to MAIN:p4 and SI1:p19–p25.

papers.title: Soft X-ray absorption and fragmentation of tin-oxo cage photoresists
papers.scope_note: Direct study of tin-oxo cage photoresist materials using thin-film soft X-ray absorption, gas-phase photofragmentation and calculations. It reports no condition-specific lithographic performance experiments; retained records describe spectroscopic film preparation rather than patterned resists.

papers.title: Novel hexameric tin carboxylate clusters as efficient negative-tone EUV photoresists: high resolution with well-defined patterns under low energy doses
papers.scope_note: Original study of two crystallographically characterized hexameric tin oxo-carboxylate clusters used as negative-tone EBL and EUV photoresists. Extraction uses supplied article/SI text and only the eight supplied SI page images.

papers.title: Highly hydroxylated hafnium clusters are accessible to high resolution EUV photoresists under small energy doses
papers.scope_note: Primary study of proposed hydroxylated hafnium oxo cluster 3 as a negative-tone EUV and EBL resist, with related hafnium clusters as benchmarks. Cluster 3 was not crystallographically resolved, and the coated-film structure is not established.

papers.title: Insight into the evolution upon ionization from tin-oxo cage photoresist and counterions by DFT calculation
papers.scope_note: Direct computational study of a tin-oxo cage EUV photoresist and counterion effects on ionization, electron attachment and Sn–C cleavage. It reports no condition-specific lithography experiments, so records is empty.

papers.title: A novel stable zinc-oxo cluster for advanced lithography patterning
papers.scope_note: Original study of discrete zinc–oxo cluster resists: Zn–VBA tested by EBL and EUV, Zn–TBA tested as an EBL comparator, and Zn–BA characterized as a control.

papers.title: Ligand effect on In-Ti-oxo nanoclusters for nanolithography
papers.scope_note: Original study of In–Ti-oxo clusters, with negative-tone EBL demonstrated for InOC-20V and comparative solubility and film-forming studies of three analogues. EUV suitability is discussed, but no EUV lithography experiment is reported.

papers.title: Synthesis of pentameric chlorotin carboxylate clusters for high resolution EUV photoresists under small doses
papers.scope_note: Original experimental study of a pentameric chlorotin oxo/hydroxo carboxylate cluster blended with a 12-tin oxo cage for negative-tone EBL and EUV lithography. Includes constituent controls, an OH-counterion comparator and etching tests.

papers.title: A highly hydroxylated 6-tin oxide cluster serves as an efficient e-beam and EUV-photoresist to achieve high-resolution patterns
papers.scope_note: Primary experimental study of a proposed hydroxylated six-tin oxo resist, with precursor and tin-cluster comparisons in EBL, EUV and etching. Cluster (1) is crystallographically resolved as an isolated precursor; neither its coated-film structure nor retention of the proposed cluster (2) framework is established.

papers.title: Advances in direct optical lithography of nanomaterials
papers.scope_note: Review with no new experimental data. Extraction focuses on metal–oxo clusters, metal–organic frameworks and directly related oxide/metal-organic precursor resists; all retained results are literature comparisons, not experiments performed for this review.

papers.title: Recent progress of inorganic photoresists for next-generation EUV lithography
papers.scope_note: Review of metal-organic, metal-oxo, nanoparticle and dry-deposited photoresists, with related pattern-transfer approaches. Extracted results are literature comparisons, including previously published work by the review authors, not new experiments performed in this review.

papers.title: Hybrid alkyl-ligand tin-oxo clusters for enhanced lithographic patterning performance via intramolecular interactions
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of a crystallographically resolved hybrid-alkyl Sn4-oxo precursor used as a negative-tone, non-chemically amplified EBL/EUV resist, with a physical-mixture comparator. The precursor structure is resolved, but retention of that structure in coated films is not established.

papers.title: Insight into the mechanism of different substituents on the zinc-oxo cluster in solubility switching
papers.scope_note: Direct computational study of zinc-oxo EUV-photoresist components and solubility-switch mechanisms, not an experimental lithography study. No condition-specific lithography performance records are established by the supplied evidence.

papers.title: Advances in metal-based photoresist materials for EUV lithography and lithographic mechanisms
papers.scope_note: Review of metal-based photoresists, including metal–oxo clusters, metal-organic molecular resists and related inorganic–polymer hybrids. All extracted results are literature comparisons, not experiments performed for this review.

papers.title: Extreme ultraviolet induced reactions of tin–oxo cage photoresists
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of negative-tone n-butyltin–oxo cage resists TinOH and TinF, emphasizing EUV solubility switching, film retention and outgassing rather than nanoscale pattern resolution. TinOAc results are retained only as an explicitly identified literature comparison.

papers.title: Design of three functionalities in hexameric tin oxide clusters to enhance e-beam lithographic quality and edge resistance ability
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of hexameric organotin-oxo negative-tone resists, including hydroxylation, condition-specific EBL, surface quality and etch resistance. EUV exposures support mechanistic analysis, not demonstrated EUV lithographic resolution in this study.

papers.title: Transport in gold cluster structures defined by electron-beam lithography
papers.scope_note: Ligand-stabilized gold clusters function as a directly patterned negative-tone electron-beam material, although the study primarily concerns electrical transport. This is a related metal-organic cluster resist, not a metal-oxo resist.

papers.title: Directed self-assembly of InAs quantum dots on nano-oxide templates
papers.scope_note: This study concerns directed growth of InAs quantum dots through patterned SiO2 growth-inhibition masks, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresists. PMMA is the EBL resist; the oxide aperture sizes and quantum-dot dimensions are not performance measurements of an in-scope resist (MAIN:p2–MAIN:p4).

papers.title: Reduction of metal contact resistance of graphene devices via CO 2 cluster cleaning
papers.scope_note: This study investigates CO2 gas-cluster removal of polymer residues to reduce graphene–metal contact resistance, not photoresist material development or lithographic performance. CO2 clusters are cleaning media, PMMA is a graphene-transfer support, and Cr/Au forms electrodes rather than a metal-containing resist.

papers.title: Extreme ultraviolet photoemission of a tin-based photoresist
papers.scope_note: Direct study of three n-butyltin oxo-cage photoresists, focused on EUV photoemission rather than lithographic performance. Records retain the reported film and irradiation series without inventing patterning results.

papers.title: Extreme ultraviolet-excited time-resolved luminescence spectroscopy using an ultrafast table-top high-harmonic generation source
authors: van der Geest, M. L. S.
papers.scope_note: Instrumentation study directly examining a fluorophore-tagged zirconium oxo-cluster photoresist by DUV/XUV luminescence spectroscopy. Relevant material identities and a cited relative dose-to-gel comparison are retained, without inventing patterning experiments.

papers.title: Tin-oxo nanoclusters for extreme ultraviolet photoresists: Effects of ligands, counterions, and doping
papers.scope_note: Direct computational investigation of Sn12 oxo-cage EUV photoresists, varying ligands, counterions and endohedral dopants. Calculated absorption, ligand detachment and stability are retained separately from the cited experimental absorption comparison; no experimental lithography performance is invented.

papers.title: Deep-UV laser direct writing of photoluminescent ZnO submicron patterns: an example of nanoarchitectonics concept
papers.journal: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF ADVANCED MATERIALS
papers.scope_note: This study demonstrates negative-tone DUV patterning of ligand-functionalized ZnO nanocrystal films, a related inorganic nanoparticle resist rather than an atomically defined metal-oxo cluster resist. Surface composition is not a resolved molecular formula, and precursor identity does not establish an unchanged coated-film structure.

papers.title: Large-scale Au nanoparticle cluster arrays with tunable particle numbers evolved from colloidal lithography
papers.scope_note: This study fabricates citrate-stabilized Au nanoparticle cluster arrays on quaternized PDMAEMA brush templates using polystyrene colloidal masks, oxygen-plasma etching and electrostatic assembly for SERS (MAIN:p2–MAIN:p4, MAIN:p8). Neither the Au nanoparticles nor the polymer templates are studied as photoresists; electron-beam lithography appears only as background.

papers.title: Inorganic ligand capped quantum dot light-emitting diodes: status and perspective
papers.scope_note: Review of inorganic-ligand-capped quantum dots for LEDs, not metal-oxo or metal-organic photoresist experiments (MAIN:p2). Direct optical patterning is discussed qualitatively (MAIN:p15), but no identifiable material/condition-specific lithography performance is reported; bibliography entries alone were not converted into resist records.

papers.title: Preparation of the polymerizable titania oriented to 3D printing and the laser-induced crystallization
papers.scope_note: This study develops AAEM-functionalized titania as a polymerizable pigment additive in a TMPTA resin for 405 nm stereolithographic 3D printing. It reports bulk photocuring, pigmentation, dispersion stability and printed-part mechanical properties, rather than metal-oxo/metal-organic photoresist lithography performance; printing layer thickness and crystallite size are not lithographic feature sizes.

papers.title: Progress in metal organic cluster EUV photoresists
papers.journal: Journal of Vacuum Science and Technology B Nanotechnology and Microelectronics
papers.scope_note: Research/progress article directly reporting metal oxide nanoparticle and metal-organic nanocluster lithography. Reprinted figures and explicitly previous-study results are retained as literature_comparison rather than new experiments.

papers.title: Fabrication and near-room temperature transport of patterned gold cluster structures
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF VACUUM SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY B
papers.scope_note: Non-oxo, ligand-stabilized gold clusters are directly patterned by negative-tone electron-beam exposure and solvent removal of unexposed material. Although the paper primarily studies electrical transport, it reports relevant metal-organic cluster lithography results.

papers.title: Photochemical conversion of tin-oxo cage compounds studied using hard x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanolithography MEMS and Moems
papers.scope_note: Direct study of TinOH, a molecular tin-oxo cage identified as a negative-tone EUV resist. This study measures DUV-induced photochemical conversion rather than condition-specific lithographic patterning performance.

papers.title: Extreme ultraviolet patterning of tin-oxo cages
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF MICRO-NANOLITHOGRAPHY MEMS AND MOEMS
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental study of negative-tone tin-oxo cage EUV resists, emphasizing TinOH, TinA and TinM processing and patterning. TinS is retained as a precursor and absorption-property material, without inventing a separate lithography result.

papers.title: Elucidating the patterning mechanism of zirconium-based hybrid photoresists
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF MICRO-NANOLITHOGRAPHY MEMS AND MOEMS
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of zirconium-oxo methacrylate hybrid EUV photoresists, emphasizing molecular-weight-dependent scumming and exposure-induced ligand dissociation.

papers.title: Absorption coefficient of metal-containing photoresists in the extreme ultraviolet
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanolithography MEMS and Moems
papers.scope_note: Experimental EUV absorption study of five tin-oxo cage salts and three Zr/Hf oxocluster photoresists. The reported experiments measure pristine-film absorption, not dose-dependent patterning performance.

papers.title: Stochastics in extreme ultraviolet lithography: Investigating the role of microscopic resist properties for metal-oxide-based resists
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanolithography MEMS and Moems
papers.scope_note: Directly addresses metal-oxide cluster EUV non-CARs using Monte Carlo and analytical models benchmarked against experimental contact-hole data. SnO2 and PMMA are model constituent surrogates, not proof of the experimental resist composition or retained film structure.

papers.title: Mechanistic insights in Zr-and Hf-based molecular hybrid EUV photoresists
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanolithography MEMS and Moems
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of Zr- and Hf-methacrylate metal oxocluster negative-tone EUV resists, with condition-specific contrast and patterning results.

papers.title: Stability studies on a sensitive EUV photoresist based on zinc metal oxoclusters
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanolithography MEMS and Moems
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of a tetrameric zinc oxocluster resist bearing methacrylate and trifluoroacetate ligands, including EUV lithography, developer and bake comparisons, batch reproducibility, absorption and stability.

papers.title: Stochastic simulation and calibration of organometallic photoresists for extreme ultraviolet lithography
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanopatterning Materials and Metrology
papers.scope_note: Stochastic modeling of negative-tone Inpria-YA tin-oxide photoresist, calibrated against experimental EUV Bossung data. Simulation examples and fitted parameters are distinguished from measured lithography performance.

papers.title: Infrared nanospectroscopy characterization of metal oxide photoresists
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF MICRO-NANOPATTERNING MATERIALS AND METROLOGY-JM3
papers.scope_note: Experimental characterization of a proprietary metal oxide cluster photoresist using EBL line/space exposure and blanket UV exposure. The study establishes nanoscale chemical mapping rather than quantitative developed-pattern lithography performance.

papers.title: Ultrasensitive metal-organic cluster resist for patterning of single exposure high numerical aperture extreme ultraviolet lithography applications
papers.journal: Journal of Micro Nanopatterning Materials and Metrology
papers.scope_note: Experimental study of an indium–methacrylic acid metal-organic cluster resist under DUV, electron-beam, helium-ion-beam and EUV exposure, including etching and pattern transfer.

papers.title: Absorption coefficient and exposure kinetics of photoresists at EUV
papers.journal: Proceedings of SPIE the International Society for Optical Engineering
papers.scope_note: Direct experimental EUV absorption study of five tin-oxo cage salts and three Zr/Hf oxocluster resists. Records describe absorption exposure conditions, not demonstrated patterning performance; the separate organic-CAR bleaching study is outside the requested metal-resist extraction.

papers.title: Photochemical conversion of tin-oxo cage compounds studied using hard x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
papers.journal: Proceedings of SPIE the International Society for Optical Engineering
papers.scope_note: Direct study of DUV photochemistry in TinOH tin-oxo cage resist films under air and dry N2. The reported experiments examine chemical conversion rather than lithographic patterning performance.

papers.title: Extreme ultraviolet patterning of tin-oxo cages
papers.journal: Proceedings of SPIE the International Society for Optical Engineering
